description: This file implements the Hibernate-based Data Access Object (DAO) for the application context, providing methods for user authentication, session management, cache control, search index management, and database connection handling within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: HibernateContextDAO
classes.description: Implementation of the ContextDAO interface using Hibernate, providing session and transaction management, user authentication, cache control, and search indexing functionalities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Assigns the Hibernate SessionFactory to be used by this DAO.

methods.name: setUserDAO
methods.description: Sets the UserDAO instance for user-related database operations.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user given a username and password, including lockout management and session handling.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its UUID without flushing the session.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User by username via the UserDAO.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified roles and password.

methods.name: saveUserProperties
methods.description: Persists user property changes.

methods.name: getUsersLoginAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of login attempts for a given user.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a Hibernate session and binds it to the transaction synchronization manager.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes the current Hibernate session and unbinds it from the transaction synchronization manager.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the current Hibernate session.

methods.name: evictFromSession
methods.description: Evicts an object from the current session cache.

methods.name: evictEntity
methods.description: Evicts a specific entity from the cache.

methods.name: evictAllEntities
methods.description: Evicts all entities of a given class from the cache.

methods.name: clearEntireCache
methods.description: Clears all caches in the session factory.

methods.name: refreshEntity
methods.description: Refreshes an entity from the database.

methods.name: flushSession
methods.description: Flushes the current session.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Placeholder method for startup logic.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the session factory and logs cache statistics.

methods.name: showUsageStatistics
methods.description: Logs Hibernate cache and query statistics.

methods.name: mergeDefaultRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Merges default hibernate properties into runtime properties.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForType
methods.description: Updates the search index for a specific entity type.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Rebuilds the entire search index for all entity types.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForObject
methods.description: Updates the search index for a specific object.

methods.name: setupSearchIndex
methods.description: Checks the search index version and updates if necessary.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Updates the search index and sets version property.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexAsync
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous update of the search index.

methods.name: getDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Provides a JDBC connection to the database.
